kind: logistic regression, L2 (C=0.1), 1 feature: pool age (younger = higher). The only signal whose direction held in every slice tested (Sep 25-26 and Oct 1-3, all tradeable rows and the bot's own filter region) and that matches Cross Chain's strongest stable signal
label: win = price reached +20% before -25% within 60 min of the evaluation price (timeout = 0), DexScreener/Jupiter quotes, before costs

training.population: tradeable rows of scoring.db: past the age+liquidity stages, pool liquidity > 0, mcap/liq >= 1.3; one row per coin per 30 min

inputs: the bot's evaluation metrics dict (scanner metrics JSON stored in evaluations.metrics) + chain + bucket
pipeline: raw = feature definition (below) from the metrics dict; undefined/None/non-finite -> missing
x = min(max(raw, clip_low), clip_high)  (missing stays missing)
logit = intercept + sum(coef * z);  prob = 1 / (1 + exp(-logit));  score = round(prob * 100, 1)

features.name: log_age_min
features.definition: ln(1 + metrics['age_min']) - pool age in minutes; missing if None or < 0

domain_guard: if liq > 0 and mcap > 0 and mcap / liq < 1.3: out of model domain (liquidity ~= market cap pools). score_v1 returns score 0.0, prob 0.0
output: score 0-100 = probability x 100 (NOT on the same scale as the current 0-100 score; do not compare thresholds)
top10pct_use: stricter gate for the new account while a soft daily cap is active (Trading Bot's 'score >= 75, half size' rule); same basis as below but the 90th percentile
threshold_basis: 80th percentile of this model's score on 63 test-period rows (2026-10-01T03:35-04:00 onward) that reached the bot's score gate -> about the top 20% of coins the gate sees
warnings: WEAK MODEL. No multi-feature model beat chance out of sample for this bot (Oct 3 report; a 2-feature age + buy/sell model scored test AUC 0.466). This 1-feature model (younger pool = higher score) is the most defensible option, not a proven edge: in the Sep 25-26 training period age barely separated wins (AUC 0.494 inverted); the edge shows only in Oct 1-3.

Because it uses only pool age, the new account will effectively buy the youngest coins that pass the existing filters (min pool age 10 min). Ties/ordering among same-age coins fall back to the bot's normal candidate order.

Within the bot's own filter region (candidates with 1h change <= 75%) the single signals that looked strongest (1h change, market cap, liquidity) reversed direction between Sep 25-26 and Oct 1-3, so they were left out.
Train rows are mostly Sep 25-26 (before the rug check, liquidity floor raise and the Jupiter scan source).

Selection bias: the feature was chosen after looking at how signals behaved in the Oct 1-3 period too, so the validation numbers (test AUC 0.664) overstate what to expect. Only the forward side-by-side test counts.
Threshold 48.4 is equivalent to a pool younger than about 98 minutes (score 59.2 at 10 min, 50.8 at 60 min, 47.4 at 120 min, 36.1 at 24 h).
plain_words: Higher score for younger pools. Buy (new account) when score >= 48.4, i.e. pool age under ~98 min, among coins that already passed every existing filter.
